hero.title: Privacy Policy
hero.subtitle: Your privacy matters to us. This page explains how Sky Galaxy collects, uses, and protects your information when you interact with our website, mobile app, and services.

sections.title: Information We Collect
paragraphs: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as when you create an account, place an order, or contact us through a form or customer support, including your name, phone number, email address, and shipping address.
We also automatically collect certain information as you browse the site, such as browser and device type and the product pages you visit, to improve your experience and the site's performance.

sections.title: How We Use Your Information
paragraphs: Personally identifiable information is used by the company only to process your requests, respond to your inquiries, market our products and services, and improve your experience on the site.
list: Processing and fulfilling orders, shipping, and payments
Communicating with you about your orders or inquiries
Sending offers and updates about our products and services (you can opt out at any time)
Improving the site and developing our services based on usage patterns

sections.title: Confidentiality & Non-Personal Information
paragraphs: No confidential relationship is created between you and the company simply by transmitting information to us through the site. Any information the company receives through the site, other than your personally identifiable information, is considered non-confidential.
Please do not send any confidential information or information owned by a third party through the site's forms.

sections.title: Information Security
paragraphs: The company takes reasonable precautions to keep all information obtained from online visitors secure and protected against unauthorized access or use, and regularly reviews its security procedures.

That said, no method of transmission over the internet is completely secure, so we ask that you avoid sending sensitive financial or confidential information through the site's forms or unencrypted email.

sections.title: Cookies
paragraphs: Our site uses cookies and similar technologies to remember your preferences, power your shopping cart, and analyze site usage to improve performance and speed.
You can control or block cookies through your browser settings, though disabling them may affect some site functionality.

sections.title: Sharing Information With Others
paragraphs: The company does not sell your personal information to third parties. We may share limited information with trusted service providers (such as shipping carriers and payment processors) only to fulfill the service you requested.
We may disclose your information if required by law, or to protect the company's rights or the safety of our users.

sections.title: Your Rights Over Your Data
paragraphs: You can contact us at any time to request access to the information we hold about you, request corrections, request deletion, or unsubscribe from marketing communications.
list: Access the personal data we hold about you
Delete your account yourself at any time, as explained in the next section
Unsubscribe from marketing communications at any time

sections.title: Deleting Your Account
paragraphs: You can permanently delete your account at any time from the website (My Account › Security › Delete account) or from the same section in the mobile app. If you signed up with an email and password, you will be asked to enter your password to confirm. If you can't sign in, contact us and we will delete the account for you after verifying your identity.
Deletion takes effect immediately and cannot be undone. You can register again later with the same email, but it will be a new, empty account.
The following data is deleted permanently as soon as you confirm:
list: Your account details: name, email address, phone number, password, and profile picture
The link between your account and Google, Facebook, or Apple sign-in, if you used one
All your active sessions on every device

sections.title: What We Keep After Deletion
paragraphs: Some data is not deleted with your account, either because the law requires us to keep it or because it is not linked to your account. We keep it only as long as necessary and do not use it for marketing.
list: Past orders and their invoices (items, amounts, the shipping name, phone and address, and payment status) are kept as financial and tax records as required by law, and are used only for accounting, returns, and disputes
Messages and quote requests you sent through the site's forms are not linked to your account, so they are not deleted automatically; you can ask us to delete them through the contact page
Backup copies may hold your data for a limited period until they are overwritten in the normal backup cycle

sections.title: Children's Privacy
paragraphs: Our site and services are not directed at children under the age of 18, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from them. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us so we can remove it.

sections.title: Changes to This Policy
paragraphs: The company may update this privacy policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or for operational, legal, or regulatory reasons. We encourage you to review this page periodically; the last-updated date at the top of the page will be revised accordingly.

contact.title: Have a question about your privacy?
contact.description: Our team is ready to answer any question about how your data is collected or used.

meta.title: Privacy Policy - Sky Galaxy | Insulation & Construction Materials
meta.description: Learn how Sky Galaxy collects, uses, and protects your personal information, and your rights over your data when shopping on our site.
